source.note: single-card witness of the STATE resource stem 'counters' (CR 122) reached via PROLIFERATE (CR 701.34) -- a DISTINCT counter-ADDING manner from titanias-boon's direct +1/+1 PUT. Oracle (whole card): 'Landfall -- Whenever a land you control enters, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)' The ability's SOLE effect is proliferate, so the counters emit is THE witness; the landfall trigger is incidental subscription context (a land-ETB deployment watch), not the witnessed port. AST faithfulness: proliferate parses to ProliferateEffect (libs/magic-ast/AST/Effects/Counter/ProliferateEffect.cs, [OracleEffect('proliferate')]) -- a PARAMETERLESS keyword action with NO CounterType, NO Count, NO Target/Subject (the GLOSSARY: 'which permanents and players are chosen is a game-state decision handled at the table'). So the honest emit is the BARE counters stem with attrs={}: no facet is AST-derivable. PROJECTION GAP (parser-target, Deadeye-shaped): the live engine does NOT project a counters emit -- ProliferateEffect is absent from PortWalkProjection.EffectTypes and falls to the coarse emit:proliferate fallback (known-coarse-projections.json: 'baseline coarse fallback ... no flow rule consumes it yet'). This canonical counters port is therefore a PARSER-TARGET, the same shape as deadeye-x-peregrine-drake (blink projects emit:gainability today); source records the target rather than authoring a wish silently. TWO axis questions SURFACED (ANTI-PROLIFERATION -- NOT invented): (1) a counter-ADD manner axis -- proliferate (add-one-of-each-existing-kind) vs a direct put has no home: the 'manner' axis is licensed_by [removal:*, deployment:*] only (not counters) and its enum {sacrificed,destroyed,combat,state-based,blink,cast,copied} has no put/proliferate value; (2) counter-type='each kind already there' is an existential over the EXISTING kinds on the object -- not any single closed counter-type enum value (+1/+1|loyalty|charge|energy|experience|poison) and counter-type carries_provenance_or_polarity=false, so it cannot even be marked producer-choice. SAGA INTERACTION (user-flagged, not yet projectable): a Saga advances by putting a lore counter each upkeep (CR 714) -- proliferate adds another lore counter of that existing kind, ACCELERATING the Saga's chapter clock; SagaAbilityParser.cs notes Saga bodies are 'a counter/proliferate interaction surface once Saga bodies project', so the proliferate->lore-counter payoff edge is unwitnessable today (Saga chapters do not project ports) -- left for when both proliferate and Saga bodies project. No edhrec_rank in the testbed oracle-cards.json source (verified) -- popularity omitted, not fabricated.
